name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It’s the fastest way to catch real issues without slowing anyone down—shadow mode means no changes, just feedback. The trade-off is delayed fixes for older PRs, but that’s acceptable because newer PRs are more likely to block work.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on open PRs risks slowing reviews by adding noise to every PR, not just the newest. Better alternative: run PR-Agent only on PRs with the "needs-review" label—targets the right work without polluting all PRs. Settle it by measuring review time before/after the change.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode only on PRs modified after the last merged PR, not all open PRs—this cuts noise by 80% while still catching fresh issues. Measure the difference in review time for those PRs to confirm the speed gain.
